iconicAnchor.label: OBS scene composed from gameplay, webcam, text, and browser sources
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: OBS scenes combine games, webcams, text, images, and browser-based alerts into a single broadcast layout, establishing the layered production basis of an audience-facing stream surface.

sources.title: OBS Studio Overview Guide
supports: Scenes and sources combine game capture, webcams, images, text, and other media into the broadcast output.
Distinct scenes support audience states such as welcome, game, break, and ending.

sources.title: Twitch's Alerts
supports: Twitch describes alerts as personalized in-stream signals for community actions such as subscriptions and new followers.
Twitch's guidance connects alert customization to a channel's unique brand and to clearer audience awareness of what happened and who did it.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches performance signal, interface signal, digital signal, screen scale, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/live-stream-overlay/generated-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
